Message.Name: Sequence Reset Message
Message.Description: Sent on each multicast channel at start of day, and intraday in case of a disaster recovery. The client must ignore the sequence number of the Sequence Reset message itself and set the next expected sequence number to NewSeqNo, clear all cached data for all instruments and subscribe to the refresh channels to receive the current state of the market.

Field.Name: NewSeqNo
Field.Description: New sequence number. Always set to 1.
